oracle: an expired document's card is a placeholder for everyone but its owner (A14.6)
what: the workspace card shows a stored cover whatever the expiry, so an editor's card for an expired document draws its owner's cover

target.case: A14.6 cover backfill: one cover POST per card that lacks one, none for a trusted scripted deck, a document not on screen or a reload; an expired document gets its cover from its owner's workspace only and stays a placeholder for its editor

expect.message: the expired card stays a placeholder for the editor
